title: Local Optimality of the d-cube for Laplacian Eigenvalues
summary: For each $d \ge 2$ we prove that the unit $d$-cube $\square_d \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is, on the class $\mathcal{P}$ of convex polytopes combinatorially equivalent to a $d$-cube, (i) a strict local minimizer of the scale-invariant isoperimetric ratio $I(Ω) = \tfrac{P(Ω)^d}{|Ω|^{d-1}}$, with $P$ the perimeter, (ii) a strict local minimizer of the volume-normalized first Dirichlet eigenvalue $\barλ(Ω) = |Ω|^{2/d}λ_1(Ω)$, and (iii) a strict local maximizer of the volume-normalized first Neumann eigenvalue $\barμ(Ω) = |Ω|^{2/d}μ_1(Ω)$.
